sources.title: Hahmdong/SPUPER-qwen3.5-9b-acaciawl-add - featherless.ai
sources.snippet: Hahmdong/SPUPER-qwen3.5-9b-acaciawl-add is a 9 billion parameter language model fine-tuned from Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B. Developed by Hahmdong, this model leverages SFT (Supervised Fine-Tuning) for enhanced performance. It is designed for general text generation tasks, building upon the robust Qwen3.5 architecture with a 32768 token context length.
